WPMS No.2758 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Basant Singh, learned counsel i/b Mr. Harshpal 
Sekhon, learned counsel for the petitioner for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Devendra Pant, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. Learned State Counsel pursuant to order dated 
8.9.2025 has brought the SOP issued by the Central Govt. 
regarding deposit of Arms Licence, as required by this 
Court, but from a perusal of the said SOP, it is argued by 
learned State Counsel that there is no requirement for 
depositing the Arms Licence. However, the learned 
Standing Counsel submits that there may be some 
notification issued under Section 24-A of the Arms Act, 
1959. He seeks time to bring the notification on record. 
He would file the SOP as well as the notification issued 
u/s 24-A of the Act along with the supplementary affidavit 
within three weeks.
4. List on 26.11.2025.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
